name: @pi/assistant-evals
description: promptfoo suites for the PI assistant (design §8). Separate lockfile keeps promptfoo out of the function bundle.

scripts.validate: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo validate -c promptfooconfig.yaml
scripts.eval:smoke: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml -j 1 --filter-metadata tier=smoke --no-progress-bar -o results.json
scripts.eval:full: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml -j 1 --no-progress-bar -o results.json
